# Theprescription

> Free AI Doctor Prescription Reader, Online Prescription Scanner & Medical Handwriting Decipherer

Theprescription is an AI-powered healthcare literacy platform that assists patients, caregivers, and pharmacists in deciphering handwritten doctor prescriptions, identifying generic chemical equivalents, clarifying Latin dosing shorthand (1-0-1, BD, TDS), and generating safe, printable daily medication schedules.

## Core Resources
- [AI Doctor Prescription Reader](https://www.theprescription.in/): Free online prescription reader and multi-engine OCR vision system for interpreting cursive doctor handwriting, handwritten clinic slips, and medical abbreviations.
- [Medicine & Generic Salt Directory](https://www.theprescription.in/#lookup): Comprehensive clinical index of 5,000+ brand medications, active generic pharmaceutical salts, dosage forms, and affordable equivalents.
- [Doctor Abbreviation Dictionary](https://www.theprescription.in/#abbreviations): Decoded Latin prescription notation including 1-0-1, OD, BD, TDS, AC, PC, SOS, HS, and STAT.
- [Clinical Health Blog](https://www.theprescription.in/#blog): 17 evidence-based clinical guides on medication literacy, deciphering unreadable prescriptions, pediatric dosing, drug-food interactions, and chronotherapy.
- [Medical FAQs](https://www.theprescription.in/#faq): 62 physician-verified answers covering prescription handwriting recognition, storage protocols, missed doses, and polypharmacy safety.
- [Clinical Mission & Principles](https://www.theprescription.in/#about): Mission statement, privacy architecture, and zero-retention health data philosophy.
- [Medical Disclaimer](https://www.theprescription.in/#disclaimer): Critical safety notice and guidance on consulting licensed healthcare professionals.
